newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Alestra says 50 mln mins in phone calls.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Alestra says 50 mln mins in phone calls.

text.p: Mexican long-distance carrier Alestra clocked up more than 50 million minutes of calls in the year to the close of May, the company president said on Monday.

"In the first five months of the year, more than 50 million minutes of telephone calls were made through the Alestra network, which represents more than 200 million minutes billed," Alestra director Jorge Escalona said at a news conference.
Mexico's long-distance telephone market opened to competition on January 1, after former state-owned company Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) held a monopoly for decades.
Alestra is a joint venture between conglomerate Alfa, financial firm Visa-Bancomer and U.S. based AT&T Corp.
